subject: general
question: Which of the following is a government initiative aimed at improving urban infrastructure in Indian cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smart Cities Mission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Smart Cities Mission is an urban renewal and retrofitting program launched by the Government of India in **June 2015**.
 
• Its main objective is to promote sustainable and inclusive urban development by creating **100 smart cities across the country.**
 
• The mission focuses on **smart solutions** for better infrastructure, improved governance, and enhanced quality of life for citizens.
 
• Key areas include solid waste management, water supply, urban mobility, energy efficiency, and e-governance initiatives.
 
• The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is responsible for implementing the Smart Cities Mission in collaboration with state and city governments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atal Bhujal Yojana (ABHY):**

 
 
• Launched in December 2019 by the Government of India to improve **groundwater management**.
 
• Focuses on ensuring sustainable water availability in **critical and overexploited areas**.
 
• Implemented by the Ministry of Jal Shakti with funding from the World Bank.
 
 
 
• **Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban):**
 
 
• A national initiative launched in 2014 to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management.
 
• Part of the larger Swachh Bharat campaign, focusing on urban areas and municipal infrastructure improvements.
 
• Emphasizes behavioral change and public participation for sanitation awareness.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):**
 
 
• A rural development program aimed at providing **all-weather road connectivity** to unconnected villages.
 
• Launched in **December 2000** by the Ministry of Rural Development.
 
• Critical for improving economic and social infrastructure in remote areas.
 
 
 
• **Urban Infrastructure Development:**
 
 
• The Government of India has introduced various schemes like AMRUT (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation) to improve urban infrastructure.
 
• AMRUT emphasizes water supply, sewerage, urban transport, and green spaces in cities.
 
• Efforts are being made to integrate technology with urban planning for sustainable growth.
